annotations.title: One site's structure from its sitemaps: sections, new and removed pages, what fails

description: Wraps GET /api/sites/{slug}/map. One site's structure from its sitemaps: sections, new and removed pages, what fails. Call this to see where a site is changing or breaking without crawling it: every path with pages under it, with new and removed pages in the window, pages that fail, broken links and sitemaps that miss pages. Add ?section= for one section's pages. Our sites only (competitors' sitemaps aren't read).

range.description: the window for new and removed pages

section.description: a section path such as "/c" to list its pages

name: sites_by_slug_map

checked.description: pages the monitor checks itself; the rest are known from the sitemap

firstFetchAt.description: pages listed then count as there from the start, never as new

history.description: the whole site's days in the window (at least two), oldest first; kept 400 days, since monitoring began

items.description: One day of a sitemap's history

pages.description: pages listed at the day's end

linkChecked.description: listed URLs link-checked in the last 7 days, when every sitemap URL is checked

date.description: content date (published, created, last modified), else first seen

hasBrokenLinks.description: it has an open broken-links incident

missingFrom.description: sitemaps that should list it and don't

title.description: its title, from the sitemap or the page

tone.description: up: no known problem; warn: warnings or more than 20% removed; down: a page fails
